identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of SHR-A2102 in Combination With Other Anti-tumor Therapies for Resectable Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Phase II Clinical Study of SHR-A2102 in Combination With Other Anti-tumor Therapies for Perioperative Treatment of Resectable Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is a Phase II study to explore the efficacy and safety of SHR-A2102 in combination with other anti-tumor therapies as perioperative treatment in patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer.
